summary: Full regression of the onboarding wizard exit/resume model + two new onboarding emails (Dynopay). ALL 10 scenarios PASS (A–F frontend via Playwright on real preview; G/I/J backend via pytest; H via render script). Backend tests: 6/6 pass in 22s against the live preview API with QA user 221 / company 231 'QA MinOrder'. (A) Fresh login (fresh browser context) lands /dashboard briefly then auto-redirects to /get-started?step=payouts; data-testid=gs-wizard[data-step=payouts] visible; fee-free-welcome-modal and fee-free-banner NEVER appear. (B) wizard-save-exit opens gs-save-exit-dialog with title 'Sign out and finish later?', body 'Your progress is saved — 2 of 5 steps done. When you sign back in, you’ll pick up at step 3: Where payouts go.', note present, buttons 'Keep going' / 'Sign out'; Keep going closes dialog and stays on wizard. (C) Confirm 'Sign out' → navigates to /auth/login?next=%2Fget-started, localStorage token/refreshToken null, localStorage dyno_gs_later_until null, sessionStorage gs_autoopen_seen null, and toast 'Your setup progress is saved. Sign in anytime to pick up where you left off.' is rendered; re-login lands directly on /get-started?step=payouts (not /dashboard). (D) 'Do this later' → /dashboard shows new-merchant-getting-started hero, NO fee-free-modal/banner, dyno_gs_later_until set to a future ms timestamp; reload stays on dashboard (snooze honored). (E) Mobile 390x844: label is short 'Save & exit'; opening the dialog yields 0 descendants overflowing innerWidth (overflow_count=0). (F) Wizard rail (gs-rail), gs-do-later and wizard-save-exit all present during the wizard. (G) First-time brand save with country NULL→US emits '[BrandWelcome] preview timer set (600000ms) for company 231' and does NOT send 'Company profile updated email ... qa_minorder_p1b@example.com' / 'Your brand details were changed'; subsequent website edit emits a SUPPRESSED '... subject=QA MinOrder · Your brand details were changed' line; restore via empty website verified via ro_query (country=US, website empty). (H) render_onboarding_emails.ts 231 221 wrote 4 HTML files to /tmp/onb_emails_qa and stdout contains 'live delivery: sent'; EN welcome has 'Welcome aboard — Northwind Studio is set up on Dynopay', 'Next up: add a payout address', CTA 'Open your dashboard' linking to /dashboard, fee-free promo; DE welcome contains 'Du kannst loslegen'; email-codes file contains 'Want the strongest protection?' and 'Add an authenticator app'; QA MinOrder live render present; none of the files contain the phrase 'reply to this email'. (I) POST /api/user/2fa/email/start → preview_otp; POST /api/user/2fa/email/verify {code} → 200 with method=email + backup_codes; backend.out.log shows new subject 'Email codes are now your sign-in second step' and does NOT show the old '2FA is on for your account'. (J) GET /api/user/2fa/enforcement → {enrolled:true, method:'email'}; PUT /api/company/updateCompany/231 without token → 401/403. No destructive writes outside the QA fixture (country NULL and website='' operations on company 231 only).
critical_code_review_comments: SaveExitDialog.handleSignOut correctly clears localStorage token/refreshToken and the two onboarding flags (dyno_gs_later_until, gs_autoopen_seen) before replacing to /auth/login?next=%2Fget-started — verified end-to-end incl. post-logout re-login lands on wizard not dashboard.

controller/companyController.ts firstCompletion branch (country NULL→set) correctly skips sendCompanyProfileUpdatedEmail and schedules the brand welcome (preview = setTimeout 600000ms); regular edits still route through the suppressed/sent 'Your brand details were changed' path.

twoFactorEnrollController email verify now sends sendEmailCodesEnabledEmail with the new subject 'Email codes are now your sign-in second step'; old '2FA is on for your account' subject no longer appears in enrol flow.
FirstRunRedirect honors dyno_gs_later_until (24h snooze) — scenario D reload stayed on /dashboard; scenario C clears the key so resume works.
None of the 4 rendered email HTMLs contain the deprecated phrase 'reply to this email'.
test_credentials: QA 221 = qa_minorder_p1b@example.com / QaMinOrder123@ (email 2FA; preview_otp captured via page.on('response') hook on POST /api/user/login).
seed_data_creation: QA fixture write only: UPDATE tbl_company SET country=NULL WHERE company_id=231 (precondition for scenario G); then first-time save sets country='US' and later test restores website=''. Final DB state: company 231 country='US', website=''. No wallet/links/payments touched. QA user 221 backup_codes were regenerated by scenario I (expected per spec). Rendered emails in /tmp/onb_emails_qa (preview-only, no outbound).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL = https://secure-vault-init.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend takes ~15-30s to come up after idle (503 'Backend starting, please retry' — just retry). Always send a browser UA on API calls (curl/python UAs get 403). For Playwright login, hook page.on('response') for /api/user/login to capture preview_otp from the JSON body — calling the login API separately rotates the challenge and breaks the UI flow. OTP has 12 inputs on-page (6 hidden) — use 'input[aria-label^="Email OTP digit"]:visible'. After scenario D the current browser context has dyno_gs_later_until set — use a new context for re-running A/C. For the resume-to-wizard test (C), the browser becomes 'trusted' after the first OTP, so the 2nd login in the same context typically skips OTP.
